correctness.rationale: On G=P3×Z transverse Laplacian eigenvalues 0,1,3 and massive scalar Green kernels q_λ^|k|/sqrt(λ(λ+4)) derive three edge orbit columns. Absolute sums and Qee give Q: vertical 1+1/sqrt5+5/sqrt21, outer-horizontal 7/3+1/sqrt5-1/sqrt21, middle 7/3; complementary C: 2+2/sqrt21, 4/3+2/sqrt5,4/3+4/sqrt21. Exact inequalities identify different maximizing orbits. Verified independently with finite 31-column graph incidence D, pseudoinverse D^T(DD^T)^†D: all six column sums within 7.5e-7 of infinite formulas. Absolute exponential summability plus ℓ2 identity justifies ℓ1 and adjoint ℓ∞ extensions; finite graph is not proof for infinite graph.
